paragraphs.text: translated by
1. FAIN would I win my friend to kindly friendship. So may the Sage, come through the air's wide ocean,
paragraphs.original: ओ चित्सखायं सख्या ववृत्यां तिरः पुरू चिदर्णवं जगन्वान् ।
paragraphs.translit: o citsakhāyaṃ sakhyā vavṛtyāṃ tiraḥ purū cidarṇavaṃ jaganvān |

paragraphs.text: Remembering the earth and days to follow, obtain a son, the issue of his father.
paragraphs.original: पितुर्नपातमा दधीत वेधा अधि क्षमि प्रतरं दीध्यानः
paragraphs.translit: piturnapātamā dadhīta vedhā adhi kṣami prataraṃ dīdhyānaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Thy friend loves not the friendship which considers her who is near in kindred as stranger.
paragraphs.original: न ते सखा सख्यं वष्ट्येतत्सलक्ष्मा यद्विषुरूपा भवाति ।
paragraphs.translit: na te sakhā sakhyaṃ vaṣṭyetatsalakṣmā yadviṣurūpā bhavāti |

paragraphs.text: Sons of the mighty Asura, the Heroes, supporters of the heavens, see far around them.
paragraphs.original: महस्पुत्रासो असुरस्य वीरा दिवो धर्तार उर्विया परि ख्यन्
paragraphs.translit: mahasputrāso asurasya vīrā divo dhartāra urviyā pari khyan

paragraphs.text: 3. Yea, this the Immortals seek of thee with longing, progeny of the sole existing mortal.
paragraphs.original: उशन्ति घा ते अमृतास एतदेकस्य चित्त्यजसं मर्त्यस्य ।
paragraphs.translit: uśanti ghā te amṛtāsa etadekasya cittyajasaṃ martyasya |

paragraphs.text: Then let thy soul and mine be knit together, and as a loving husband take thy consort.
paragraphs.original: नि ते मनो मनसि धाय्यस्मे जन्युः पतिस्तन्वमा विविश्याः
paragraphs.translit: ni te mano manasi dhāyyasme janyuḥ patistanvamā viviśyāḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Shall we do now what we ne'er did aforetime? we who spake righteously now talk impurely?
paragraphs.original: न यत्पुरा चकृमा कद्ध नूनमृता वदन्तो अनृतं रपेम ।
paragraphs.translit: na yatpurā cakṛmā kaddha nūnamṛtā vadanto anṛtaṃ rapema |

paragraphs.text: Gandharva in the floods, the Dame of Waters-such is our bond, such our most lofty kinship.
paragraphs.original: गन्धर्वो अप्स्वप्या च योषा सा नो नाभिः परमं जामि तन्नौ
paragraphs.translit: gandharvo apsvapyā ca yoṣā sā no nābhiḥ paramaṃ jāmi tannau

paragraphs.text: 5. Even in the womb God Tvastar, Vivifier, shaping all forms, Creator, made us consorts.
paragraphs.original: गर्भे नु नौ जनिता दम्पती कर्देवस्त्वष्टा सविता विश्वरूपः ।
paragraphs.translit: garbhe nu nau janitā dampatī kardevastvaṣṭā savitā viśvarūpaḥ |

paragraphs.text: None violates his holy ordinances: that we are his the heavens and earth acknowledge.
paragraphs.original: नकिरस्य प्र मिनन्ति व्रतानि वेद नावस्य पृथिवी उत द्यौः
paragraphs.translit: nakirasya pra minanti vratāni veda nāvasya pṛthivī uta dyauḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Who knows that earliest day whereof thou speakest? Who hath beheld it? Who can here declare it?
paragraphs.original: को अस्य वेद प्रथमस्याह्नः क ईं ददर्श क इह प्र वोचत् ।
paragraphs.translit: ko asya veda prathamasyāhnaḥ ka īṃ dadarśa ka iha pra vocat |

paragraphs.text: Great is the Law of Varuna and Mitra. What, wanton! wilt thou say to men to tempt them?
paragraphs.original: बृहन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम कदु ब्रव आहनो वीच्या नॄन्
paragraphs.translit: bṛhanmitrasya varuṇasya dhāma kadu brava āhano vīcyā nṝn

paragraphs.text: 7. I, Yami, am possessed by love of Yama, that I may rest on the same couch beside him.
paragraphs.original: यमस्य मा यम्यं काम आगन्समाने योनौ सहशेय्याय ।
paragraphs.translit: yamasya mā yamyaṃ kāma āgansamāne yonau sahaśeyyāya |

paragraphs.text: I as a wife would yield me to my husband. Like car-wheels let us speed to meet each other.
paragraphs.original: जायेव पत्ये तन्वं रिरिच्यां वि चिद्वृहेव रथ्येव चक्रा
paragraphs.translit: jāyeva patye tanvaṃ riricyāṃ vi cidvṛheva rathyeva cakrā

paragraphs.text: 8. They stand not still, they never close their eyelids, those sentinels of Gods who wander round us.
paragraphs.original: न तिष्ठन्ति न नि मिषन्त्येते देवानां स्पश इह ये चरन्ति ।
paragraphs.translit: na tiṣṭhanti na ni miṣantyete devānāṃ spaśa iha ye caranti |

paragraphs.text: Not me-go quickly, wanton, with another, and hasten like a chariot wheel to meet him.
paragraphs.original: अन्येन मदाहनो याहि तूयं तेन वि वृह रथ्येव चक्रा
paragraphs.translit: anyena madāhano yāhi tūyaṃ tena vi vṛha rathyeva cakrā

paragraphs.text: 9. May Surya's eye with days and nights endow him, and ever may his light spread out before him.
paragraphs.original: रात्रीभिरस्मा अहभिर्दशस्येत्सूर्यस्य चक्षुर्मुहुरुन्मिमीयात् ।
paragraphs.translit: rātrībhirasmā ahabhirdaśasyetsūryasya cakṣurmuhurunmimīyāt |

paragraphs.text: In heaven and earth the kindred Pair commingle. On Yam! be the unbrotherly act of Yama.
paragraphs.original: दिवा पृथिव्या मिथुना सबन्धू यमीर्यमस्य बिभृयादजामि
paragraphs.translit: divā pṛthivyā mithunā sabandhū yamīryamasya bibhṛyādajāmi

paragraphs.text: 10. Sure there will come succeeding times when brothers and sisters will do acts unmeet for kinsfolk.
paragraphs.original: आ घा ता गच्छानुत्तरा युगानि यत्र जामयः कृणवन्नजामि ।
paragraphs.translit: ā ghā tā gacchānuttarā yugāni yatra jāmayaḥ kṛṇavannajāmi |

paragraphs.text: Not me, O fair one,-seek another husband, and make thine arm a pillow for thy consort.
paragraphs.original: उप बर्बृहि वृषभाय बाहुमन्यमिच्छस्व सुभगे पतिं मत्
paragraphs.translit: upa barbṛhi vṛṣabhāya bāhumanyamicchasva subhage patiṃ mat

paragraphs.text: 11. Is he a brother when no lord is left her? Is she a sister when Destruction cometh?
paragraphs.original: किं भ्रातासद्यदनाथं भवाति किमु स्वसा यन्निरृतिर्निगच्छात् ।
paragraphs.translit: kiṃ bhrātāsadyadanāthaṃ bhavāti kimu svasā yannirṛtirnigacchāt |

paragraphs.text: Forced by my love these many words I utter. Come near, and hold me in thy close embraces.
paragraphs.original: काममूता बह्वेतद्रपामि तन्वा मे तन्वं सं पिपृग्धि
paragraphs.translit: kāmamūtā bahvetadrapāmi tanvā me tanvaṃ saṃ pipṛgdhi

paragraphs.text: 12. I will not fold mine arms about thy body: they call it sin when one comes near his sister.
paragraphs.original: न वा उ ते तन्वा तन्वं सं पपृच्यां पापमाहुर्यः स्वसारं निगच्छात् ।
paragraphs.translit: na vā u te tanvā tanvaṃ saṃ papṛcyāṃ pāpamāhuryaḥ svasāraṃ nigacchāt |

paragraphs.text: Not me,-prepare thy pleasures with another: thy brother seeks not this from thee, O fair one.
paragraphs.original: अन्येन मत्प्रमुदः कल्पयस्व न ते भ्राता सुभगे वष्ट्येतत्
paragraphs.translit: anyena matpramudaḥ kalpayasva na te bhrātā subhage vaṣṭyetat

paragraphs.text: 13. Alas! thou art indeed a weakling, Yama we find in thee no trace of heart or spirit.
paragraphs.original: बतो बतासि यम नैव ते मनो हृदयं चाविदाम ।
paragraphs.translit: bato batāsi yama naiva te mano hṛdayaṃ cāvidāma |

paragraphs.text: As round the tree the woodbine clings, another will cling about thee girt as with a girdle.
paragraphs.original: अन्या किल त्वां कक्ष्येव युक्तं परि ष्वजाते लिबुजेव वृक्षम्
paragraphs.translit: anyā kila tvāṃ kakṣyeva yuktaṃ pari ṣvajāte libujeva vṛkṣam

paragraphs.text: 14. Embrace another, Yami; let another, even as the woodbine rings the tree, enfold thee.
paragraphs.original: अन्यमू षु त्वं यम्यन्य उ त्वां परि ष्वजाते लिबुजेव वृक्षम् ।
paragraphs.translit: anyamū ṣu tvaṃ yamyanya u tvāṃ pari ṣvajāte libujeva vṛkṣam |

paragraphs.text: Win thou his heart and let him win thy fancy, and he shall form with thee a blest alliance.
paragraphs.original: तस्य वा त्वं मन इच्छा स वा तवाधा कृणुष्व संविदं सुभद्राम्
paragraphs.translit: tasya vā tvaṃ mana icchā sa vā tavādhā kṛṇuṣva saṃvidaṃ subhadrām
